sources.title: Does Pi-1-1 determinacy imply 0#?
sources.publication: In Set Theory, Oberwolfach Reports 02/2014, pp. 127–128
sources.reliance: Exact lightface coanalytic determinacy implication over set-theoretic Z3; separation from HP. The short OWR footnote mentions omission of Power Set; the explicit Collection convention is taken from CS.
sources.recorded_inspection: The statement text was read and both pages were visually inspected during source review. The proof attempt reused those retained bytes and did not claim a new visual inspection of these pages. The mathematical audit checked the relevant public passages.

sources.title: Harrington's Principle in Higher Order Arithmetic
sources.version_status: Retained arXiv:1503.04000v1, 13 March 2015; cited journal publication as above.
sources.reliance: Set-theoretic Z3 with Collection, the full real-coded iterable active-premouse sharp sentence and its Sigma-1-3 complexity, the classical Martin–Harrington theorem in ZF, HP calibration/separation, and the Z4 hull argument. These are cited premises; the fine-structural coding equivalence and forcing consistency construction are not independently reproved.
sources.recorded_inspection: Retained text read at the listed locations. PDF pp. 1–2 were visually inspected during source review; p. 6 was newly rendered and visually inspected during the proof attempt and checked during the audit.

sources.title: Analytic determinacy and 0#: A forcing-free proof of Harrington's theorem
sources.reliance: The forcing-free route still concludes via HP and Silver's implication; removal of forcing does not itself settle formalization over the weak base. The recursion-theoretic lemmas are not independently reproved.
sources.recorded_inspection: Full seven-page text read during the proof attempt. Printed p. 158 was rendered and visually inspected in the attempt and audit. An audit web reopening returned HTTP 403; the already retained paper was used and no fresh successful audit download is claimed.

bounded_literature_context.title: Determinacy from sharps
bounded_literature_context.scope: Only publisher search-result metadata and abstract were inspected during the proof attempt. The abstract concerns sharps for every real over ZFC, a different hypothesis/base. A web opening failed; no full-paper theorem is relied on.
